description: The remaining class-(a) records from the global-resolution audit (PR #382): processes whose top-level steps still speak US institutions. Restructuring one means moving the US mechanics into a step-level geoResolutions US entry so the step text becomes the global abstraction (the first-wave pattern pinned in lib/__tests__/processGeoResolutions.test.ts). When a record is restructured, remove it here; lib/__tests__/processGeoResolutions.test.ts fails if a listed record already carries resolutions, or if a listed id leaves the corpus.
